questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How famous sports stars escaped from poverty
The best sports for keeping fit and healthy at home
How sport helps young people from tough backgrounds
Why surfing has become so popular in South Africa
questions.why: Neil says they'll discuss how sport can change the lives of young people from the poorest backgrounds.

questions.q: Why did Tim Conibear start giving free surfing lessons?
options: He noticed township kids hardly ever went to the beach
He wanted to find and train future surfing champions
The South African government asked him to do it
He needed to earn some extra money as a surf coach
questions.why: Sam says he noticed kids from poor townships hardly ever went to the beach.

questions.q: According to Tim Conibear, why is surfing good for children who have experienced trauma?
options: It is easy, so everyone can succeed very quickly
It gives them a good reason to stay away from school
It helps them earn money from competitions
Doing something difficult builds their confidence
questions.why: He says learning a challenging skill and being recognised by a coach is very good for confidence.

questions.q: What result has been reported among Cape Town's young surfers?
options: Better exam results
Much less violent behaviour
More children becoming professional surfers
Fewer children going to the beach
questions.why: Sam says there has been a significant reduction in violent behaviour.

options: A school in Kabul asked him to give skate lessons
Afghan children built their own skateboards from wood
Children were fascinated by Oliver's skateboard
A charity sent hundreds of skateboards to Afghanistan
questions.why: Sam says Oliver was travelling with his skateboard and the children were fascinated, so he taught them.

questions.q: Which children does Skateistan focus on especially?
options: Girls
Boys over seventeen
Children from rich families
Children who already skate
questions.why: Neil says the focus is on children with disabilities, from low-income backgrounds and especially girls.

questions.q: According to Jessica Faulkner, why does skateboarding teach life skills?
options: Children learn it in a classroom with a teacher
It is a team sport, so children must work together
Coaches give special lessons on life skills after class
You fall a lot, which builds determination
questions.why: She says you have to fall off a lot before you get better, which helps with resilience and determination.

questions.q: What does Jessica Faulkner say is also really important?
options: Winning competitions
Children having fun
Learning quickly
Parents joining in
questions.why: She says, “really importantly, we do believe that children should have fun.”
